yaml:
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w4-poolkey-c
spec:
  agentSelector:
    - kind:kubernetes
  podTemplate:
    reuse: true
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: job
          image: alpine:3.20
          env:
            - name: W4_POOLKEY_DISCRIMINATOR
              value: "c"
  steps:
    - name: identity
      run: echo "W4-POOLKEY-C-HOSTNAME=$(hostname)"
